title: MRL ReviewVerdict (untrusted)
description: The ONLY object Codex returns in the Minimum Reliable Loop. It is UNTRUSTED and carries a verdict, a human-readable rationale, and references to CONTROLLER-ISSUED evidence ids, and nothing else. It has no SHAs, origin, branch, model or executable identity, no gate/test results and no digests; the controller constructs the git-bound CodexDecision from its own observed facts (D-024-R502/R503). additionalProperties is false. verdict APPROVE is only an untrusted reviewer opinion and never itself produces a COMPLETE/advance decision (D-024-R504); each evidence_ref_id must match an id the controller issued for this review.
